result: New negative-result extension: a(6) > 5e8. More importantly, a(4) and a(5) are also not found through 500M — representing an unexpected gap in the multiplicity spectrum. Only 29 numbers have exactly 3 representations through 500M; zero have 4 or 5. This suggests a(4), a(5), a(6) may have extreme lower bounds well beyond prior expectations. a(6) > 6e11 (from prior census) remains the strongest bound.
next_gate: Raise census cutoff from prior 6e11 toward 1e12 on private compute host (where ~100GB virtual memory for sorted arrays or chunked external sort is available), specifically targeting detection of a(6). Prior run at 6e11 found no a(6) and two numbers with multiplicity 5 (next rung down) — use those as search seeds for the extended window.
